items.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
items.summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

items.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
items.summary: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

items.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
